issue.title: adapter-codex structured calls fail with ENAMETOOLONG under long temp roots (mkdtemp)
issue.body:
Found by WP-F5 (#102 launch diagnosis) and confirmed by its independent GPT-6.1 Sol review on 2026-10-19. Outside every I01 to I07 bolt; filed for triage.

## Defect

`packages/adapter-codex/src/structured.ts:15` creates its working directory with `mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'graphgoblin-structured-'))`. On Windows `mkdtemp` fails with `ENAMETOOLONG` once the final path reaches 248 characters (247 passes), so under a long temp root the public `CodexStructured.complete()` fails before any harness start.

## Steps

1. Point `TEMP`/`TMP` at a directory whose path is 226 characters long.
2. Call `CodexStructured.complete()` (no real turn is needed to reach the failure).

Expected: the structured call starts the harness.

Actual: `ENAMETOOLONG` with zero harness starts.

## Fix shape

Use the same pattern WP-F5 introduced for the Claude probe directory in `packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts` (`probeDirectory()`: `mkdir` of a short random-suffix name with a bounded `EEXIST` retry). WP-F1's unmerged branch adds a similar `mkdtemp(..., 'gg-codex-probe-')` at `packages/adapter-codex/src/cli.ts:92`, which reaches exactly 248 characters under a 226-character root; the orchestrator resolves that one when F1 integrates.

## Related

#102, WP-F5 record `docs/qa/2026-10-19-wp-f5-launch-diagnosis.md`.


## Intent 4 delivery admission — November 21

Admitted after [intent 3 engineering delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7059784448) on signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`, under the owner's ordered batch and delegated blocker-decision authority. [D171 and its alternatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/427#issuecomment-7059806202) distinguish coordinator selection from human plan approval. Historical parking text above remains history.

Correct the current structured-call temporary-directory defect using bounded exclusive short-name creation with safe collision and cancellation/cleanup behavior. Preserve unrelated/colliding paths and working-directory precedence.

Implementation and opposite-family review use the named routing models at xhigh. **Independent QA agent (planned):** `i4_363_behavior_qa`, a separate context and checkout; actual provider/session/build/evidence will be recorded when dispatched. GPT owns architecture; Claude Code contributes implementation, design critique, QA and adversarial review. Preserve touched-system positive/negative QA, unchanged coverage, current-head/current-target CI, fresh independent Astra MAX final audit and the three-general-scan cap. No implementation, QA or acceptance is implied by admission. Owner-only closure obligations and held460/Mac501 remain separate.
